segmentation.text: shall not open the door of or board or alight from
the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic
in such a manner as to interfere with

elements.justification: The person who opens a door, boards or alights is not observable as such; the conduct is the door of a vehicle opening, so the rule judges the vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose door it is. Same words mapped to the vehicle aggregate by LVMC_11_22_010.
sig.door_open: 'a door open; side ∈ {traffic, curb}'. Opening the door, boarding and alighting through that side all show as the door on that side being open.
'the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic' is the value side = traffic of sig.door_open; the vehicle is the subject (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle).

'vehicular traffic': road users that are traffic (admitted DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, 'vehicles and other conveyances … using any highway for purposes of travel') and vehicles (DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle); 'moving': not at rest, the negation of drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation').

operationalizations.standard: in such a manner as to interfere with
operationalizations.convention: While the traffic-side door is open, a moving vehicle of the traffic is interfered with where it touches the subject (rel.contact) or passes alongside it (rel.longitudinal_overlap: the two projections on the subject's heading share length) with a lateral body gap (rel.surface_gap, lateral component) no greater than the lateral reach of an open side door, p.door_swing_reach: it then drives through the space the open door takes.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle and its door on the side closest to passing traffic is open (sig.door_open side traffic).
obligation: No road user c that is traffic and a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic and DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and not at rest (not drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), or alongside it (rel.longitudinal_overlap: projections share length) with the lateral component of rel.surface_gap(subject, c) at most p.door_swing_reach; violated where one is.

narrowings.why: 'A person' who opens the door, boards or alights is read through the vehicle's traffic-side door being open: who is at the door is not observable.
Boarding and alighting are read through the open traffic-side door they pass through; boarding or alighting from a vehicle side that has no door is not read.
Interference is read as a moving vehicle touching the subject or passing alongside within the open door's reach; a moving vehicle that brakes or swerves earlier to avoid the door is not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car parked at the curb opens its traffic-side door; a moving car passes alongside it with a lateral body gap of 0.5 m.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A car parked at the curb opens its traffic-side door; a moving car passes alongside with a lateral body gap of 2.5 m.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car parked at the curb with all doors closed while traffic passes close by.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car parked at the curb with traffic passing close by; the source declares sig.door_open absent.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A car parked at the curb opens its traffic-side door with no other road user in the scene.

param_proposals.name: p.door_swing_reach
param_proposals.convention: lateral reach of an open passenger-car side door beyond the vehicle body (a front door opens about 0.9 to 1.1 m)

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition source
